tally._note_test_mode: Set test_mode to false when running on the actual LAN with TallyPrime running

setu._note: Replace endpoint and api_key with actual SETU ingest URL and key

_setup_notes.tally_gateway_server: SERVER:9999 (Tally's own internet sync - not used by SETU)
_setup_notes.connection_approach: Bridge agent runs on LAN, polls port 9000 via HTTP XML, forwards to SETU over HTTPS
_setup_notes.firewall_requirement: Outbound HTTPS only from bridge machine to SETU - no inbound rules needed
_setup_notes.tally_setting_required: In TallyPrime: F12 > Advanced Config > Client/Server must be ON on port 9000
